summary.quote: a) Infracciones muy graves recogidas en el artículo 13.1: hasta 35.000.000 euros o, si el infractor es una empresa, hasta el 7 % de su volumen de negocios mundial total

Constituye infracción muy grave, relativa a los sistemas de alto riesgo, la ausencia de notificación por un proveedor de sistemas de IA de alto riesgo, o del responsable del despliegue en su defecto, de cualquier incidente grave
contenido sintético de audio, imagen, video o texto, de marcar los resultados de salida de tal modo que pueda detectarse su naturaleza artificial.
A tal efecto, se elaborará un inventario de sistemas de IA para el sector público estatal
Cada entidad del sector público estatal deberá designar, en el ejercicio de sus competencias, a un delegado de IA
Se designa a la AESIA como punto de contacto único
dispuesto en esta ley, y en especial, el Real Decreto 817/2023, de 8 de noviembre, que establece un entorno controlado de pruebas

judgment.status_reasoning: The BOCG of 12 June 2026 publishes the government bill, referred on 8 June 2026 to the Committee on Economy, Trade and Digital Transformation, with amendments due by 30 June 2026. Today is 18 Oct 2026; no later stage is stored, and a bill stays Draft / proposed until it is passed and published in the BOE. Legal force Proposed.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2025-03-11, the Council of Ministers' first approval of the draft (referencia of that day); date_last_updated 2026-05-26, its approval of the proyecto (referencia of 26 May 2026). Both referencias are labelled official as the Council's record of its agreements. With the referencia of 11 March 2025 as secondary_url, a later run stores it in the secondary role, which caps it at alt-official; such a run should ask for it as an extra source to keep date_published at official.
judgment.source_kind_reasoning: The BOCG is the legislature's publication of the bill's text, an official register. The referencia del Consejo de Ministros is the Council's formal record of the agreements adopted at its meeting (its summary lists each agreement by type and title), so it counts as the deciding body's formal record of its decision.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Unchanged: a government bill implementing the EU AI Act in Spain; in scope with no note.
